newsitem.title: USA: NFL-GOVERNORS SUPER BET: CREAM PIES/TURKEYS FOR CHEESE/BRATWURST.
newsitem.headline: NFL-GOVERNORS SUPER BET: CREAM PIES/TURKEYS FOR CHEESE/BRATWURST.

text.p: It will be Boston cream pies and roast turkeys on the line against cheese and bratwurst in the bet between governors from the respective states boasting this years's Super Bowl contestants.

Massachusetts Gov. William Weld told reporters Monday he has a bet with Gov. Tommy Thompson of Wisconsin that the New England Patriots will beat the Green Bay Packers in the January 26 Super Bowl in New Orleans.

"I called Gov. Tommy Thompson of Wisconsin this morning and advised him that this game is going to be a tuna-cheese melt and the tuna is going to wind up on top," Weld said. Patriots' coach Bill Parcels is nicknamed the Big Tuna.
The bet -- 31 Boston cream pies and 31 roast turkeys against 31 wheels of cheese and 31 kilos of bratwurst.
Both Weld and Thompson are expected to attend the 31st Super Bowl at the Superdome.
